prompt: Use an instructor-provided unseen disposable local metrics case, or a learner-created and learner-owned unseen disposable case, that is materially different from the LES-0028 guided fixture and answered scenarios. The case must include at least one independently resetting counter, one missing or stale series, one distribution metric, one deliberate label-cardinality defect, one query population or vector-matching defect, one alert-state problem, and one ambiguous dashboard panel. Without opening ASM-0067, ASM-0068, the lesson's complete-answer or product-company sections, or any generated solution after the independence gate, investigate the case. Produce a sanitized evidence package that defines the user operation and measurement contracts, diagrams the source-to-decision path, records baseline and predictions, distinguishes observation/inference/hypothesis, tests at least four ranked hypotheses, corrects metric and PromQL contracts, bounds cardinality/sample/retention/query cost, designs a safe alert and dashboard, demonstrates authorized recovery and cleanup, and gives a five-minute interview explanation with at least twelve explicit proof limits.
deliverables: Completed independence, authorization, environment and sanitization gate before investigation
User-operation, metric-type, unit, label-domain, timestamp, reset, population and missing-data contracts
Raw sanitized baseline and faulted evidence with exact commands, times, windows, steps, labels, units and result shapes
At least four ranked falsifiable hypotheses with predicted, confirming and rejecting evidence
Corrected PromQL or equivalent query sketches for rate, ratio, distribution, saturation and absence
Cardinality, samples-per-second, retention and query-work estimates with assumptions and uncertainty
Alert state, ownership, severity, runbook, routing and missing-data design plus deterministic test evidence
Dashboard question hierarchy, units, scope, freshness, no-data behavior and drill-down contract
Authorized containment, abort, rollback, user recovery, monitoring recovery and exact cleanup proof
Security and privacy review for labels, endpoints, APIs, dashboards and retained evidence
Five-minute interview explanation and at least twelve precise proof-limit statements
evidenceRequirements: The case was unseen and materially different from published guided and answered scenarios
The learner was authorized to operate only on the disposable local target and recorded all help received
No secrets, personal names, employer names, customer data, raw identifiers or private path segments are submitted
Every claim links to raw sanitized evidence, a calculation, a declared contract, or is labeled inference, hypothesis or unknown
Counter-reset, zero-traffic, missing-series, scrape-gap, vector-match, threshold-edge, pending, firing and recovery branches are addressed
No production, shared, online cloud, or employer system is modified or queried
Cleanup proves exact absence of every process, port, file, container, network or other resource the case was allowed to create
A qualified reviewer confirms no answer leakage, fabricated evidence, unsafe action or mastery inflation

rubric.observableEvidence: Unseen case, declared help, authorized disposable scope, raw sanitized evidence and no answer leakage or fabrication.
Types, units, labels, series, samples, timestamps, resets, populations and missing states are precise.
The full source-to-decision path names owners, state, failures, evidence and limits.
Rates, aggregation, ratios, matching, histograms, absence and time controls answer declared questions.
At least four hypotheses are ranked, falsifiable and tested with discriminating evidence.
Rules are tested; alert ownership/state/runbook and panel question/unit/scope/no-data/drill-down are explicit.
Bounds domains, active series, sample rate, retention and query work without fabricated precision.
Minimizes sensitive/untrusted data, protects endpoints and stored evidence, and uses least privilege.
Containment is reversible with abort/rollback; user and monitoring recovery are separate; exact cleanup passes.
The interview response is clear and at least twelve proof limits are technically specific.
